# Cue v1.0.1

本版本改进看板中的任务创建和截止日期分组，并修复任务列表的分组标签与默认优先级。

## 本版内容

- 优先级看板各列及截止日期看板的今天、明天、无截止日期列新增任务按钮；新任务自动使用所在列的优先级或截止日期。
- 截止日期看板将逾期任务与今天到期的任务分开显示。
- 在 Today 视图新建任务时，默认优先级为 P3。
- 未分组的任务列表隐藏分组标签，桌面与移动端行为保持一致。
- 下载文件统一使用包含版本和平台的名称，并提供部署配置附件；Windows 提供安装程序。

## 获取与部署

| 平台 | 获取方式 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | `Cue-v1.0.1-macos-universal.dmg`（已公证，Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用） |
| Windows | `Cue-v1.0.1-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Android | `Cue-v1.0.1-android-universal.apk` |
| Web 与 API | `docker-compose.yml` 与 `example.env`；镜像为 `ghcr.io/lz00qs/cue/cue-web:1.0.1` 和 `ghcr.io/lz00qs/cue/cue-api:1.0.1` |
| iOS | 由开发者另行通过 App Store 交付 |

Cue 需要自行部署服务端。按 [中文部署说明](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/blob/v1.0.1/README.zh.md)或 [English setup guide](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/blob/v1.0.1/README.md)配置服务端后，再连接客户端。将 `example.env` 复制为 `.env`，与 `docker-compose.yml` 放在同一目录；启用 HTTPS 配置时，还需从本版本源码取得 `docker/https.conf`。升级已有部署前，请确认备份可恢复，再拉取镜像并重新创建容器。

[完整变更](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1)

## English

- Add task buttons to priority board columns and the Today, Tomorrow, and No due date columns of the due-date board. New tasks inherit the column's priority or due date.
- Show overdue tasks separately from tasks due today on the due-date board.
- Default new tasks in Today to P3.
- Hide group labels in ungrouped task lists on desktop and mobile.
- Use versioned platform-specific download names and include deployment configuration files. Windows is distributed as an installer.

Deploy your own Cue server before connecting clients. Follow the [English setup guide](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/blob/v1.0.1/README.md), copy `example.env` to `.env` beside `docker-compose.yml`, and configure your deployment. The HTTPS profile also requires `docker/https.conf` from this version's source. Verify a restorable backup before upgrading an existing deployment, then pull the images and recreate the containers. API and Web images are published to GHCR with the `1.0.1` tag. iOS is delivered separately through the App Store.
